title: a component port that contradicts the App spec
why: App spec port is 8080 (works.yml components[0].port); 8081 is a different port that no component declares.

title: an image that is tagged `latest` instead of pinned by digest
why: CONTRACTS §9 — the image is never `latest` and a Deployment uses the digest.

title: a literal value where a generated secret belongs
why: The env entry is `secret: true` with `generate: { kind: chars, length: 32 }`; only a reference or a generated placeholder may appear.
